description: What changes the law across the whole corpus in a window of dates: what has entered into force, started applying, been replaced by a new version or reached a deadline in the last months, and what will in the next ones. Each event says whether it is an entry into force or an application, and its act's position on as_at. Window with since/until or last_months/next_months (left out: the last 6 and the next 12 months, echoed); filter by kind, jurisdiction (eu, uk), subject_matter or instrument (regulation, directive, decision). Paged by cursor, with the total and the coverage: how many acts have no resolved date, are held, or are not indexed yet. Answers "what starts applying in the next 12 months" and "what changed in the last 6".

as_at.description: The day to read the position on, YYYY-MM-DD. Left out, it is the act's legal day today (Brussels for EU law, London for UK law). It is always echoed back.

kinds.description: Only these kinds of event. Leave out for all.

since.description: First day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

subject_matter.description: A subject matter label, e.g. 'data protection'.

until.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_changes
